fact: Finance minister Joseph Mwanamvekha said Malawi's coming national census and related economic surveys are budgeted at about $55 million, with the US Census Bureau, UK ONS and UNFPA expected to co-finance; no enumeration date is given.
The story says Malawi held a 2018 Population and Housing Census; the enumeration date is not given.
The story says Malawi is preparing its 7th Population and Housing Census, scheduled for September 2028, and its statistics office held a benchmarking mission in Zambia on 7-11 September 2026.
